steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $dir = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/open-forms/'; $ctx = new WordPress\Plugin_Check\Checker\Check_Context( $dir . 'open-forms.php' ); $repo = new WordPress\Plugin_Check\Checker\Default_Check_Repository(); $checks = $repo->get_checks( WordPress\Plugin_Check\Checker\Check_Repository::TYPE_STATIC ); $res = new WordPress\Plugin_Check\Checker\Check_Result( $ctx ); foreach ( $checks as $c ) { try { $c->run( $res ); } catch ( Throwable $e ) { file_put_contents( $dir . 'pc-err.txt', get_class( $c ) . ': ' . $e->getMessage() . "\n", FILE_APPEND ); } } file_put_contents( $dir . 'pc-out.json', json_encode( array( 'errors' => $res->get_errors(), 'warnings' => $res->get_warnings() ) ) );
